verdict.rationale: The LangGraph CLI builds and runs the Agent Server locally, with its own managed database for checkpointing and storage, so a separate local environment exists for testing (docs-23, docs-30, docs-37). The persistence docs reserve database-backed checkpointers for production, which implies a lighter dev/test setup (docs-13). Nothing documents this as a sandbox that guarantees production data stays untouched. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox or staging environment docs, documented isolation from production data stores, test or mock tooling for agent tools with side effects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
